{"thought": "customers.signup_date 是註冊日期欄位。先抽樣確認日期格式，並同時計算 2025 年 3 月的筆數，避免格式不一致造成漏算。", "tool": "sql_query", "args": {"queries": ["SELECT signup_date FROM customers LIMIT 10", "SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2025_03 FROM customers WHERE signup_date LIKE '2025-03%'"]}}

response: {"thought": "2025-03 的計數只用 LIKE 比對，若日期格式不一致可能漏算。先檢查非 YYYY-MM-DD 格式的筆數，以及以嚴格格式計算的 3 月筆數。", "tool": "sql_query", "args": {"query": "SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN signup_date GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS iso_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN signup_date GLOB '2025-03-[0-9][0-9]' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS strict_2025_03, SUM(CASE WHEN signup_date IS NULL OR signup_date = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS blank_rows FROM customers"}}
